items.text: The Applicant the Applicant The Applicant The applicant-to-seat ratio for NEET-PG has held near 1 in 3 in recent cycles, even after seat counts expanded. Undergraduate MBBS seats have grown faster than postgraduate seats, which means every passing year adds more MBBS graduates competing for a postgraduate ladder that is not growing at the same pace.

items.heading: Strip Away the Words "Mbbs
items.text: Strip away the words "MBBS graduate" and look at the raw material five and a half years of medical school and internship actually gave you.

rows: Graduates who like scientific depth and one-to-one conversation with senior doctors, without prescribing anything themselves.
The best-paid non-clinical lane on this list, but companies mostly hire MSLs with 2-5 years of relevant experience, not fresh graduates.
Graduates who like running systems, budgets, and teams more than running a patient list, and want a leadership ceiling that clinical seniority alone does not offer.
You are betting on a second degree and 2 years of B-school-style study before the pay curve turns upward.
Health-tech and digital health product roles
Graduates comfortable with ambiguity, data, and product thinking who want to shape how care is delivered at scale.
Companies want your clinical judgment paired with product or business skill you have not been taught; you have to build that half yourself.
Graduates who write clearly, do not mind desk work, and want a low-cost, fast way to start earning without another entrance exam.
Entry pay is modest compared to clinical duty pay; the real income shows up after 3-5 years of specialised, provable output.

items.heading: If You Do Not Crack
items.text: If you do not crack NEET-PG on the first attempt, keep re-attempting until you do, with no parallel plan.

items.heading: Non
items.text: Non-clinical work is only for doctors who "could not make it" as specialists.

items.heading: Medical Writing, Medical Affairs,
items.text: Medical writing, medical affairs, and health-tech are "not real medical careers.".
